metadata.scenario_context: Multiple tech companies from around the globe have come together for a substantial project and have scheduled a meeting in July to measure the work progress

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tunisia agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the July 9
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Peter
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Mark, have you thought about the meeting date in July? I think July 9 would work really well for everyone. What do you think? 

Also, I've been curious... you mentioned the army rule in our last discussion. Why do you believe having the army rule is bad? I don't see it that way.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message:
July 9 sounds good, but we should confirm with everyone involved first. It’s important to make sure it works for the whole team. 

As for the army rule, it’s just... it leads to a lack of freedom and stifles progress. I believe that a system with more democratic governance is better for the people's needs. That's *exactly* my point.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Peter
shared_prefix.message:
I agree confirming with everyone is important. Let's push for July 9, and I can help with that coordination. 

But about the army rule... I think it can maintain order and stability. Sometimes, a strong hand is necessary for progress. Democracy isn’t the only way to meet people’s needs. What do you think about that?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: I don’t know about that. At the end of the day, it’s all the same. Different systems have their pros and cons, but people figure it out. I mean, having a strong hand can work, but it’s not the only way to approach things. We can just focus on coordinating for July 9. That’s what really matters right now.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Peter
turns.message:
